buildIdentityDiscrepancyResolution.rootCause: In Phase 16.9.3, computing git rev-parse HEAD before commit and writing it to tracked public/build-manifest.json created a circular hash invalidation loop where amending the commit changed its SHA, causing the tracked manifest commit SHA (7b68da7866d53bd278ee49fc5426a0423c27841c) to disagree with the final commit SHA (f7191af04ba9b039b0e9035ad4ecf48f4d8ac609).
buildIdentityDiscrepancyResolution.architecturalRemedy: Decoupled Git source tracking from generated runtime artifacts. Converted public/build-manifest.json to a static BUILD_TEMPLATE. The authoritative runtime manifest is now generated dynamically during compilation into dist/build-manifest.json. In GitHub Actions CI, process.env.GITHUB_SHA is injected directly from github.sha. In local worktree builds, git rev-parse HEAD is read without modifying any tracked files. Compilation no longer dirties Git state.
